claim: Degeneracy of the st-tw order for skew-t (text after Proposition 4)
quote: It is worthwhile noting that the st - tw order does not hold for the skew-t since if Ui ~ chi^2_{nu_i}/nu_i for i = 1, 2, then E(U1) = E(U2) = 1. So, if S1 <=st S2 holds, from Theorem 1.A.3 in Shaked and Shanthikumar (2007), U1 >=st U2 holds. Therefore, taking into account Theorem 1.A.8, we get U1 =st U2; and thus S1 =st S2 holds, i.e. nu_1 = nu_2.
